papers.title: Double/Debiased Machine Learning for Treatment and Structural Parameters
papers.metadata_title: Double/Debiased Machine Learning for Treatment and Causal Parameters
facts: The target is a low-dimensional parameter identified by a population estimating equation with nuisance parameters.
Neyman orthogonality requires a zero pathwise derivative of the expected score with respect to the specified nuisance directions.
DML1/2 partition i.i.d. observation indices and train each nuisance estimate using only the complementary observations before evaluating the orthogonal score on the held-out fold.
papers.interpretation: Our within-example token partition and shared contextual/neural parameters establish none of these independence, nuisance-estimation or orthogonal-score conditions. Do not import DML inference or bias guarantees.
papers.identity_note: Exact arXiv ID/version and authors match. API and PDF titles differ between Causal and Structural Parameters; this variant is retained explicitly.

papers.title: A²-Nets: Double Attention Networks
facts: The first attention step gathers global descriptors by second-order attention pooling.
The second step distributes those descriptors using location-conditioned soft attention.
Equation 6 composes feature gathering and feature distribution with three learned transformations of the same input.
papers.interpretation: Two-stage gathering/distribution is established prior art. These inspected equations do not impose disjoint donor/recipient folds or our noisy-utility risk comparison. That limited distinction is not novelty clearance.

papers.title: XCiT: Cross-Covariance Image Transformers
scope: pp3-4 Section 3 introduction and Sections 3.1-3.2 through equation 1 and column normalization
facts: XCA attends along the feature dimension rather than the token dimension.
Equation 1 gives V times a softmax of column-normalized key-query cross-covariance divided by a temperature.
Each query/key column is normalized over its token axis before constructing the channel interaction matrix.
papers.interpretation: Cross-covariance channel attention and data-dependent shared feature maps are established. They should not be renamed as our novelty. The inspected operation is not the proposed donor-utility-to-opposite-token-fold route.
